page.overview:
Who is Buck Withers?

Buck Withers is a male Earth pony who appears in the IDW comics story arc Neigh Anything. He is a former student of Canterlot Academy and bully to Shining Armor.

Buck Withers is inspired by James Spader's character Steff McKee in the 1986 romantic comedy film Pretty in Pink; IDW comics artist Andy Price even describes Buck as "James Spader in "pretty in Pink"... with four legs." When asked on Twitter if Buck was related to the Kill Bill: Volume 1 character Buck, Price answered "no, only shares the name".

Buck Withers resembles a pony in My Little Pony Micro-Series Issue #4 page 8 panels 2-6.

Buck Withers appears in the - story arc Neigh Anything. In a flashback to Shining Armor and Princess Cadance's days at Canterlot Academy, Buck is a popular yet self-absorbed school student and captain of the polo team who regularly bullies Shining Armor and his friends. He is especially sought after by Cadance's friends Diamond Rose and Lemony Gems.
